description: RaspiBolt v3: Bitcoin & Lightning full node on a Raspberry Pi
readme_summary: Build your own self-sovereign Bitcoin and Lightning node on a Raspberry Pi. - **Published guide:** - **v4 staging preview:** *(auto-deploys from `feature/v4-rewrite`)* - **v3 archive:** *(read-only, noindex)* - **Project history and decisions:** `DECISIONS.md`: why the stack, content, and tooling choices are what they are - **Open decisions & deferred work:** `TODO.md` All guide content lives in `guide/` as `.mdx` files, standard Markdown with a few React components (Callouts, Cards). You can edit any page directly in the GitHub UI. No Next.js knowledge required. - **Versions and download URLs** use tokens like `%versions.bitcoin_core%`, `%files.bitcoinArchive%`, `%urls.bitcoinDownload%`. Definitions live in `lib/versions.json` (raw versions) and `lib/versions.ts` (derived filenames + URLs). A remark plugin resolves them at build time, even inside code fences. - **Callouts** use Fumadocs
install_commands: npm run build         # static export to out/
npm run start         # serve out/ locally
npm run types:check   # TypeScript (fumadocs-mdx → next typegen → tsc)
npm run build         # catches MDX syntax issues
